title: Theo and the Ember
author: Hazel Galloway
blurb: Felix Zhou, a thief who steals memories, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the long winter finishes falling.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
